## Discovery & Translational Science

* **GLP-1 receptor agonist use linked to reduced survival in ALS and diabetes** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.05.05.25326993)
  * A retrospective multicenter study of 308 patients with comorbid ALS and type 1 or 2 diabetes found that treatment with GLP-1 receptor agonists (n = 39) was associated with shorter tracheostomy-free survival.
  * Patients in the GLP-1RA cohort experienced a significantly shorter diagnostic delay (10.2 vs 15.9 months, p < 0.001) compared to unexposed controls.

* **CHAMP assay methodology evaluated for measuring cell membrane penetration** [In the Pipeline / Science](https://www.science.org/content/blog-post/lipidation-and-its-discontents)
  * Researchers assessed chloroalkane azide-based membrane penetration (CHAMP), a HaloTag-driven chemical biology strategy, to quantify how lipid modifications affect drug uptake across cell membranes.
  * The assay uses cell-expressed HaloTag proteins reacting with DBCO-chloroalkane vectors, followed by azide-functionalized test compounds and fluorophores to quantify internal accumulation.

* **Prior GLP-1RA non-response linked to distinct hepatic mitochondrial injury prior to bariatric surgery** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.04.26359613)
  * A prospective trial comparing patients with GLP-1RA–refractory obesity (< 5% weight loss over ≥ 6 months) to GLP-1RA–naive patients undergoing Roux-en-Y gastric bypass showed significant baseline liver pathology differences.
  * Biopsies revealed that non-responders had higher hepatic lipid accumulation, advanced mitochondrial ultrastructural abnormalities, and impaired AMPK-ACC phosphorylation.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Biotech]** **Palatin Technologies doses first patient in Phase 2b ulcerative colitis study** [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2115422086625673703)
  * Palatin initiated dosing in the global Phase 2b ASCENTRA-UC trial evaluating oral PALI-2108 for the treatment of ulcerative colitis.
  * The study has activated 29 U.S. sites and secured CTA clearance in Canada, targeting approximately 115 global sites with topline data expected in Q4 2027.

* **[Biotech]** **Monte Rosa Therapeutics triggers $37.5M milestone from Novartis** [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2115401544615252202)
  * Monte Rosa initiated a second Phase 2 clinical study for its VAV1-directed molecular glue degrader, MRT-6160.
  * The trial milestone earned the company a $37.5 million payment from licensing partner Novartis.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** **Eli Lilly’s retatrutide outperforms Ozempic in head-to-head diabetes study** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/28/retatrutide-vs-ozempic-lilly-diabetes-study/?utm_campaign=rss) | [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2115395710862737571)
  * In an 80-week trial in adults with type 2 diabetes, the GIP/GLP-1/glucagon triple agonist retatrutide reduced HbA1c by an average of 2.2% compared to 1.8% for semaglutide (Ozempic 2 mg).
  * Retatrutide treated participants achieved 20%–21% body weight loss (44–47 lbs) compared to 9% (21 lbs) in the semaglutide arm.

* **[Biotech]** **Geron discontinues Phase 3 IMpactMF trial of imetelstat** [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2115414169730031767)
  * Geron is halting the Phase 3 IMpactMF trial evaluating telomerase inhibitor imetelstat in relapsed/refractory myelofibrosis.
  * The decision follows a recommendation from the Independent Data Monitoring Committee stating the study was unlikely to meet its primary endpoint of overall survival.

* **[Biotech]** **SELLAS Life Sciences reaches final analysis event in Phase 3 REGAL trial** [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2115422563220193463)
  * The pivotal Phase 3 REGAL trial evaluating galinpepimut-S (GPS) in acute myeloid leukemia reached its pre-specified 80th event threshold.
  * Accumulation of the required events triggers the final statistical analysis, with topline overall survival results anticipated this quarter.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Biogen targets December for Phase 3 litifilimab readouts in SLE** [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2115386319048483060)
  * Biogen confirmed that topline data from both the TOPAZ-1 and TOPAZ-2 Phase 3 trials evaluating litifilimab in systemic lupus erythematosus are expected in early December.
  * The update accompanied Q3 financial results showing total revenue of $2.8 billion, driven by Spinraza ($461 million) and Leqembi ($202 million).

* **In vitro fertilization demonstrates superiority over IUI in unexplained infertility trial** [NEJM](https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa2602728?af=R&rss=currentIssue)
  * A randomized controlled trial evaluated live-birth outcomes comparing immediate in vitro fertilization (IVF) to intrauterine insemination (IUI) in couples with unexplained infertility.

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Biotech]** **FDA grants Priority Review to Palvella’s QTORIN rapamycin NDA** [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2115406105472114966)
  * The FDA accepted the New Drug Application (NDA) for QTORIN rapamycin and assigned it Priority Review status.
  * The agency set a PDUFA target action date of February 28, 2027.

* **[Big Pharma]** **FDA issues Warning Letter to Amgen over Vectibix promotional video** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/inspections-compliance-enforcement-and-criminal-investigations/warning-letters/amgen-inc-739641-08122026)
  * The FDA Office of Prescription Drug Promotion (OPDP) issued a warning letter regarding a promotional video for Vectibix (panitumumab) injection.
  * The agency determined the material was false or misleading regarding the safety and efficacy profile of the drug in colorectal cancer, violating the FD&C Act.

* **FDA issues updated guidance on approval pathways for individualized gene therapies** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/27/fda-personalized-gene-therapy-guidance-individualized-feature-space/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * The FDA detailed regulatory frameworks to streamline clinical requirements and accelerate approval pathways for bespoke gene therapies designed for ultra-rare mutations.

## Business & Strategy

* **[Biotech]** **Artiva Therapeutics liquidates operations following cell therapy deaths** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/artiva-discontinue-nk-cell-therapy-autoimmune-patient-death/872873/) | [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/27/autoimmune-cell-therapy-trial-artiva-therapeutics-shutting-down/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * Artiva is cutting 94% of its workforce and winding down operations following two participant deaths in a clinical trial evaluating its natural killer cell therapy, AlloNK, in autoimmune disease.
  * One patient died of leukoencephalopathy linked to fludarabine conditioning, while another suffered sudden death; Artiva noted the therapy also failed to demonstrate necessary clinical durability.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Ferring Pharmaceuticals to acquire Gameto in $1.4B deal** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/ferring-gameto-acquire-ivf-fertilo-womens-health/872904/)
  * Ferring agreed to acquire reproductive health startup Gameto for up to $1.4 billion in upfront and milestone-based payments.
  * The acquisition adds Fertilo, an investigational stem cell-derived platform designed to mature eggs outside the body and shorten IVF regimens to three days without hormone injections.

* **[Big Pharma]** **Court denies Novo Nordisk injunction against Eli Lilly obesity ads** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/novo-lilly-lawsuit-ruling-false-advertising-wegovy-zepbound/872856/) | [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/10/27/novo-setback-in-court-house-probe-into-big-pbms/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * A federal judge rejected Novo Nordisk's request to block Eli Lilly from running comparative ads highlighting Zepbound's weight loss performance against Wegovy.
  * The court ruled Novo failed to prove irreparable harm or commercial impact, noting Wegovy prescription volumes did not decline while the commercials aired.

* **[Biotech]** **Anthropic acquires rare disease startup Mithril Medicine** [X / @Prof_Oak_](https://x.com/Prof_Oak_/status/2115180225655177419)
  * AI company Anthropic acquired Mithril Medicine, a virtual biotech developing bispecific antibodies for LAMA2-related congenital muscular dystrophy (LAMA2-CMD) and extracellular matrix disorders.
  * Anthropic plans to leverage the acquisition to run internal rare disease drug development programs and share proprietary models with academic and industry partners.

* **[Biotech]** **Rapport Therapeutics prices $175M public offering** [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2115383588367564894)
  * Rapport Therapeutics announced the pricing of a $175 million underwritten public stock offering at $21.00 per share.

* **Nonprofit organization acquires shelved gene therapy program** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/27/biotech-news-nonprofit-resurrects-shelved-gene-therapy/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * A non-profit entity acquired a clinical-stage gene therapy asset originally developed by Bloomsbury Genetic Therapies, which was abandoned when the UK startup closed after dosing a single patient.

## Public Health & Policy

* **[Big Pharma]** **Missouri AG orders Eli Lilly to cease 340B hospital data mandates** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/10/27/missouri-ag-warns-lilly-340b-drug-pricing-data/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * Missouri's Attorney General issued a formal warning to Eli Lilly to stop requiring hospitals to submit patient claims data as a prerequisite for receiving 340B drug pricing discounts.

* **U.S. overdose deaths fall 27% in 2024 according to federal metrics** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/28/health-news-why-are-overdose-deaths-declining/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * Provisional CDC data show U.S. drug overdose deaths dropped 27% in 2024, with early indicators for 2025 showing continued declines following pandemic-era peaks.

* **Geospatial analysis identifies non-waterfowl hosts in dairy farm H5N1 outbreaks** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.1101/2024.05.02.24306785)
  * Analysis of 42 H5N1 avian influenza outbreaks across nine states showed non-waterfowl avian abundance was significantly higher in affected counties (p < 0.00001), serving as a primary marker for initial mammalian spillover.
